name: HZ_ADDTNL_PARTYIDS_INT
description: This table HZ_ACCOUNTS_INT is used to import additional simplified account attributes.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a Batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the HZ_ACCOUNTS_INT interface record.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status code for Import.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates action entered by user.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the action of insert or update for internal use.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by file import to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Stores systask id for each import csv file.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Party.

columns.name: PARTY_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identification number for this party.

columns.name: PARTY_SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original System for the Party.

columns.name: PARTY_SOURCE_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original System Reference for the Party.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original System for the additional PartyId.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original System Reference for the additional PartyId.

columns.name: PARTY_IDENTIFIER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the base table hz_addtnl_partyids_int.

columns.name: PARTY_IDENTIFIER_TYPE
columns.description: Identifier type for this ID. Values are defined in TYPE_CODE of HZ_NAME_AND_ID_TYPE_B. The party type should be consistent with the party type that the PARTY_IDENTIFIER_TYPE can be applied to.

columns.name: PARTY_IDENTIFIER_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the Identifier for the Party.

columns.name: STATUS_FLAG
columns.description: Record Status Flag used to soft delete entity. Possible values are 'A' (active), 'I' (inactive).

columns.name: COUNTRY
columns.description: Foreign key to FND_TERRITORY. TERRITORY_CODE.From UI, COUNTRY and STATE should be displayed based on geography setup. Used for certain types of identifiers such as Passports or Driving licenses.

columns.name: STATE_PROVINCE
columns.description: From UI, COUNTRY and STATE should be displayed based on geography setup. Used for certain types of identifiers such as Passports or Driving licenses.

columns.name: ISSUING_AUTHORITY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the Issuing authority.

columns.name: ISSUING_AUTHORITY_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party Id of the issuing authority, if that happens to be in the system.

columns.name: ISSUE_DATE
columns.description: Date in which the Identifier was issued. It may be NULL as it does not apply to all types of identifiers.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: Expiration date for the identifier. It may be NULL as it does not apply to all types of identifiers.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Free text comment/description.
